utterances.text: And?

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: So, the two seals that keep coming up, he's got none of one and three of the other. The common stuff he's got plenty of, that's what he meant by fine, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: And the funny thing is he still does it all off these little cards, the old lead's cards, in a shoebox, I'm not joking, they've got handwriting on from about 2009, and he said to me, he goes, the system's only ever as good as whoever counted last, and I said Dave, that's literally the returns cage at Daventry, we had this exact thing on the stock count, and then he started on about his nephew who does something with barcodes at a brewery in Tadcaster, which, I mean, he does sound quite good, they've got these handheld things that-

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Arjun.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Yes. Sorry. None and three.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: So that's, um, that's fairly clear on the shelf, I think.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Those two are fast lines. They'd have to wait for the next van.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And if it's a Tuesday, that's, what-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Up to Friday. I think that's most of the 18.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Mm. Mei, you were going to get those, um, the Harlow tickets?

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Got them. Sent them Friday. Both seals, both those part numbers.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yes, sorry, I did see that.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Read the contract too. Three misses in a quarter and the penalty kicks in. Four thousand pounds a time.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Oh, so it was Harlow with the penalty thing. I had it down as Wakefield.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Harlow. We've had two.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And that's quite a visible account, I mean, for the region that's more than just the money.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay. Hm. So I think, um, what are we actually saying here? Is the van the problem, or-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I went through the lines by volume. Not by how urgent they are.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: No, I don't think anyone's, um, nobody's blaming-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I know. I'm just saying what it showed and what it didn't.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Does anyone still have that other one? The number from Brackenfield, was that Priya's?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Priya has it. It's still valid.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Five three a month. Daily, through their cross-dock.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That's a lot more than what we told people we'd be spending, though, isn't it? The whole story was that it came down.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: It is cheaper. Brackenfield daily at 5,300 is cheaper overall, even at twelve hundred a month over the van.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Daily means the seals are there next morning. That takes out almost all of those courier orders, and the Harlow penalty exposure goes with them.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: We're at nearly three grand a week on couriers. The extra's about three hundred.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Hang on, so, the van's 4,100, plus two weeks at 5,950, call it twelve thousand a month if it carries on, that's, yeah, that's sixteen on Leeds.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: It won't all go. There were three a week before.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Almost all, I said.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: And it's still under the six six from before, that's the bit I hadn't clocked, the old way was 6,600 and that's 5,300.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I mean, I can see it. I suppose my only thing is the wider shape, we were trying to make Leeds less of a special case, and this kind of, um, isn't that a van most days again?

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: One van. Consolidated at their end. Not four cartons and a gasket kit.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay. No, that's a fair distinction, I think.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Dave'll love it, he'll say he told us so, he did actually say that about the same-day stuff, or something near it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Um, Hana, you know that one better than anyone. Does it hold up, do you think?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: The numbers do. Yes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I'd want to check their cut-off for Leeds orders. But yes.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks, Hana, I appreciate that's, um, I know that wasn't an easy one.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And I think maybe Tom won't love a higher line, but it's, hm, it's hard to argue with sixteen against five three.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: He's seen worse.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Ha. Yes. Um, does anyone want to say anything else on it, or are we, I think maybe we're there?

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: Not from me.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: No, I'm comfortable.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Harlow's still waiting.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right. So, Hana, could you maybe get on to Priya today and start the paperwork with them, and check that cut-off while you're there?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yes. This afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Thank you. And I'll, um, I'll take the numbers to Tom, the real ones this time, so he doesn't hear it over lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Send him the tickets as well.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yes, good thought, I will.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I'll need to go back to the service managers, I think, I can frame it as, you know, we looked at the evidence.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Say seals. Say next morning.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yes, okay, more specific than that, fine. Once Hana has a date from them.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: I'll tell Dave, he'll need to know, and I'll get him to order in those two seals in the meantime if Hana's happy, that's just normal stock anyway.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And the vans carry on as they are for now, I think, until we've got something signed. Hana, you'll have a look at their terms too?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: The Northway ones. Yes, I'll reread them.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Lovely. Um, is there anything else? Oh, the August cover, I think maybe it's still looking a bit thin in the third week.

utterances.speaker: Arjun
utterances.text: That's me, I'm afraid, Cork, unless the ferry people cancel it again.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I'm in that week.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Oh, good, okay. Thanks, Mei. Um, I think that's probably us, then.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Thanks, all. Holiday dates, I'm doing it now.
